blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Going topless or half-naked in public places will be prohibited in Daanbantayan, Cebu under a newly approved municipal ordinance covering both men and women and imposing penalties for violations. The Sangguniang Bayan of Daanbantayan approved Ordinance No. 11-2026, also identified as Resolution No. 644-2026, on third and final reading during its regular session on September 4, 2026. The ordinance was authored by Sangguniang Bayan Member Jose Maria C. Gastardo.
